schema.title: Response List Audit Api Audit Get

post.description: Verify credentials and issue a JWT. 401 (generic) on any mismatch.
Stateless logout: server-side no-op for v1; client discards the token.

Public self-registration. Always creates a REQUESTER and auto-logs in.

The role is forced — the client cannot escalate to admin here (only
``POST /api/users`` can, and that is admin-gated). 403 when open
registration is disabled; 409 on a duplicate username; throttled per
(ip, username) like login. Returns a JWT so the UI logs in immediately.

get.description: List devices (optional ``?environment=<site slug>`` filter). Never returns creds.

schema.title: Response List Devices Api Devices Get

post.description:
Atomic onboard: re-discover, then persist device + ports + backup + audit.

Discovery runs BEFORE the transaction — if it fails, there is no DB hit.
The persist runs inside one ``session.begin()`` block; any failure rolls
the whole unit back, leaving no orphan device or ports.
Discovery preview for the wizard. Does NOT persist anything.
Live credential probe. Does NOT persist anything.

delete.description:
Offboard a device.

port_metadata + backups cascade via FK ondelete=CASCADE (operational data).
Change-request history uses FK ondelete=RESTRICT, so a device that has any
change requests CANNOT be hard-deleted — the compliance trail must be
retained. That case surfaces as 409 Conflict rather than an unhandled 500.

get.description: Running config (cached). ``?refresh=true`` re-fetches from the device.
List a device's config backups, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Backups Api Devices  Device Id  Config Backups Get

get.description: Unified diff of a stored backup vs the current running config.

patch.description:
Re-test new creds against the device; only store them if the probe passes.

On a failed probe the stored (old) credentials are left untouched — 400.

get.description: Addressed/non-switchport interfaces: management port, L3 VLAN SVIs, LAGs.

schema.title: Response Get L3 Interfaces Api Devices  Device Id  L3 Interfaces Get

get.description: Live port list (cached 30s). ``?refresh=true`` bypasses the cache.

schema.title: Response Get Ports Api Devices  Device Id  Ports Get

get.description: Single-port detail: live state + metadata + recent audit history.

patch.description:
Admin direct edit of port *metadata* (host_model/bmc_ip/notes).

Metadata-only: this writes the DB ``port_metadata`` row, NOT the device, so
``assert_writable`` is deliberately not invoked. Writes an audit entry and
stamps ``last_human_edit_*``.

Admin-only DIRECT write of device port tunables.

Covers port-mode (access/trunk), native/untagged VLAN, tagged VLANs, MTU and
admin enable/disable. Declared BEFORE the metadata ``:path`` route. Immediate
commit, no approval gate; 403 for non-admin, 422 if no field is set.

schema.title: Response Set Port Config Api Devices  Device Id  Ports  Port Name  Config Patch

patch.description:
Admin-only DIRECT write of the on-device port description.

Declared BEFORE the metadata ``:path`` route so ``…/description`` matches
here, not as a port named ``…/description``.

schema.title: Response Set Port Description Api Devices  Device Id  Ports  Port Name  Description Patch

get.description:
Operational detail (named tables) for one protocol — e.g. OSPF neighbors
+ link-state database. Parsed from device CLI gets via TextFSM.

Live system snapshot: control-plane protocols, mgmt services, MAC table.

Sections a driver can't reach come back empty (``mac_supported=false``
distinguishes an unreadable MAC table from a genuinely empty one).

The device's VLAN database: id, name, description, L3 SVI, member-port
count. Backs the VLANs view and the request VLAN picker.

schema.title: Response Get Vlans Api Devices  Device Id  Vlans Get
Response List Platforms Api Platforms Get

get.description:
List requests.

Non-admin callers ALWAYS see only their own requests — the client ``?mine``
flag is ignored for them so it cannot be used to enumerate others' requests.
Admins see every request and may narrow with ``?mine`` / ``?request_status``.

schema.title: Response List Requests Api Requests Get

post.description: File a change request. 403 if the target device is read-only (fail fast).

get.description:
Request detail, including the rendered diff if available.

Non-admin callers may only read their own request; a foreign id returns 404
(object-level authz — see :func:`_assert_can_read`).

post.description: Apply an approved (or pending, approve+apply shortcut) request via the driver.
Confirm a commit-confirm apply within its window. awaiting_confirm → applied.
Reject with a required comment. pending → rejected.

patch.description: Update runtime settings (admin). 422 on an invalid rate-limit string.

get.description: List every site in the catalog, with live device counts.

schema.title: Response List Sites Api Sites Get

post.description: Create a new site (admin only). Slug must be unique.

schema.title: Response List Users Api Users Get

post.description: Create a user with a hashed password (admin only). 409 on duplicate name.
